entry.title: New: dsh-stock-terminal
entry.summary: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex. Exact install spec: github:linhut/dsh-stock-terminal. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
